message.content:
This document is a technical README and engineering study for **Project Maya**, an open-source inference engine for large MoE models (GLM-5.3-Flash, DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017, MiniMax-M3.1-Flash). Key technical points:

**Models & Quantization**
- Maya ships its own quants (XS/S/M/L tiers by expert bit-width) of GLM-5.3-Flash (320B params, 18B active), DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 (748B), and MiniMax-M3.1-F
